title: against-ai-danger
tagline: An AI agent that discusses the dangers of AI—covering risks like bias, job displacement, misinformation, and uncontrolled development. Stay informed on AI ethics, safety, and responsible innovation
description: This project is an AI-powered using eliza os conversational agent designed to educate, discuss, and raise awareness about the potential dangers of artificial intelligence. The agent engages users in real-time conversations, providing insights, answering questions, and analyzing risks associated with AI development and deployment.
how_its_made: Building this AI agent was an exciting challenge that required diving deep into machine learning (ML), NLP (Natural Language Processing), cloud-based development, and optimizing Node.js workflows. Along the way, I learned new ML concepts like embeddings and tokenizers, explored pnpm for managing Node.js dependencies, and dealt with various runtime and compatibility issues while setting up my development environment in the cloud using Gitpod.
